# TracedOptions.kind property

Whether the decorated method serves work or calls out for it. Reported as the `span.kind` tag. Defaults to [TraceKind.SERVER](/api/dd-trace/latest/dd-trace.tracekind/)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
kind: TraceKind;
```
